name: International Relations
notes: Applies to the Class of 2021 and later; earlier classes may follow the old requirements, which are not modeled.
At least four of the six courses must be INTR or PSCI courses taken in residence. None may be taken S/F.
Courses used for tools of political analysis cannot also satisfy the core track or breadth.
The three IR core tracks are Governance of Nations, Peace and Conflict, and Politics/Policy/Development - the same track data the IR major uses.

requirementGroups.label: Tools of political analysis (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Tools of Political Analysis (Two Courses): PSCI 107; PSCI 200: Data Analysis I; PSCI 202W: Argument in Political Science; PSCI 203W: Survey Research Methods; PSCI 205: Data Analysis II; PSCI 281: Formal Models in Political Science; PSCI 288: Game Theory

requirementGroups.label: Core track (3 courses from one track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Core Track (Three Courses from One Track): Governance of Nations; Peace and Conflict; Politics, Policy, and Development

requirementGroups.label: Breadth (1 course outside your core track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must take at least six courses ... Core Track (Three Courses from One Track)
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION - modeled on the political science minor's breadth rule; confirm the IR minor's sixth course requirement with the department.
